name: L'Appel de la Constellation — Made In Zion / UPlanet Astroport.ONE (spot 60 s)

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of tanned artisan hands smoothing wet white mineral mortar made of sand and liquid silicate over coarse woven linen fabric. Droplets of water glistening in low golden morning sunlight. Tactile organic texture, earth craft, shallow depth of field, documentary photography, shot on Kodak Portra 400
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up, slow steady macro pan: tanned artisan hands carefully smooth a creamy white mineral plaster over coarse woven fabric. Morning sunlight glints on the wet silicate paste as the fingers shape the curve. Smooth, tactile, fluid movement, shallow depth of field, shot on 35mm lens. Sound: soft scraping of wet mineral paste, gentle wind.
shots.voiceover: Nous n'attendons plus que le monde change. Nous avons réappris à pétrifier la terre...

shots.image_prompt: High angle drone establishing shot of a sculpted white limestone geodesic dome with a round glass skylight, nestled in a lush green permaculture food forest with tiered terraces, stone swales leading to clear ponds, early morning mist, warm golden sunrise light, solarpunk architecture, cinematic photography
shots.prompt: Smooth cinematic drone pull-back shot rising above the white mineral dome house surrounded by a lush green food forest. Morning mist gently drifts through the fruit trees, warm sun rays break over the horizon casting long soft shadows. Elegant continuous camera motion, volumetric light. Sound: birdsong at dawn, soft wind, airy ambient pad.
shots.voiceover: ...pour bâtir des vaisseaux insubmersibles, sans une goutte de béton pétrochimique.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up cinematic shot of a man's hand next to a handcrafted axial-flux magnetic motor rotor made of copper coils and neodymium magnets set in a polished wooden and brass hub, golden workshop dust particles floating in a warm sunbeam, copper wire spools in soft bokeh background, 50mm f/1.4, film grain
shots.prompt: Cinematic slow-motion close-up: a finger gently nudges the handcrafted axial-flux copper rotor, which spins smoothly and effortlessly, magnetic poles gleaming under golden workshop light. Floating dust motes drift through the warm sunbeam. Perfect mechanical balance, shallow depth of field, Arri Alexa look. Sound: very soft harmonic hum of the spinning rotor, quiet workshop.
shots.voiceover: Une énergie réconciliée avec le mouvement. Libre de réluctance, affranchie des monopoles.

shots.image_prompt: Low-angle medium shot of an innovative lightweight solarpunk electric cargo cart with a natural wooden and aluminum frame and a thin solar canopy roof, carrying wooden crates of fresh vegetables, on a countryside dirt trail lined with red poppies and tall grasses, soft afternoon golden light, cinematic photography
shots.prompt: Smooth low-angle tracking shot moving alongside the lightweight wooden electric cargo cart gliding silently along the grassy dirt path. Wild poppies and tall grasses sway as it passes, wheels turn smoothly, sunlight glints off the small solar canopy. Realistic ground motion, crisp focus, 24fps cinema. Sound: soft crunch of wheels on gravel, grasshoppers, light breeze.
shots.voiceover: Relier les femmes et les hommes sans brûler la terre.

shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up portrait of Solene, a 26-year-old female agro-ecologist, pale skin with delicate sun freckles, auburn hair in a thick side braid with a blade of grass woven in, vibrant green eyes, gentle smile, sage green rolled-sleeve hemp shirt, small handcrafted wood-and-brass radio transmitter slung across her chest, holding a ripe purple fig near a fig tree branch, lush food forest and stepped ponds in soft bokeh, warm golden hour backlight rim light, 85mm f/1.8, shot on Kodak Portra 400
shots.prompt: Medium close-up: the young woman gently plucks the ripe purple fig from the sunlit branch and places it into a woven basket, then looks toward the ponds below and smiles warmly. Dappled sunlight flickers across her face, a natural breeze moves the leaves. Lifelike emotion, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens. Sound: birdsong, gentle water lapping, ducks in the distance.
shots.voiceover: L'abondance n'est pas une utopie lointaine. Elle s'enracine dans chaque guilde végétale que nous semons.

shots.image_prompt: Cozy interior close two-shot inside a white lime dome home: Naima, a 30-year-old Mediterranean woman with black curly hair in a messy bun and beige linen overalls over a terracotta top, and Elior, a 35-year-old man with a trimmed light beard, short tousled brown hair and an indigo chore jacket, sitting side by side on a sculpted cream limestone bench heated by a rocket mass stove, holding steaming ceramic tea mugs, warm amber fire glow on their faces, circular skylight above, volumetric light, 50mm, shot on Kodak Portra 400
shots.prompt: Slow gentle push-in on the man and the woman sitting on the warm limestone bench, chatting softly and smiling at each other. Steam rises from their ceramic tea mugs, the fire of the rocket stove casts a warm pulsating amber glow across their faces and the curved stone wall. Peaceful hearth atmosphere, volumetric light. Sound: crackling fire, soft cups clinking, quiet warm ambience.
shots.voiceover: Un habitat qui stocke la chaleur pendant des jours, protège nos vies et régénère nos corps.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of an artisanal walnut-cased home network station with brass toggle switches, a tiny glowing amber LED and a crisp e-ink screen showing a map of connected network nodes, in a recessed white lime wall niche, a circular window behind it revealing a deep cobalt blue dusk sky with the first stars and a slender bamboo-and-copper antenna silhouette, cinematic product photography
shots.prompt: Close-up with a smooth camera tilt: the e-ink display of the walnut-cased station refreshes with network glyphs and the tiny amber LED pulses gently, then the camera tilts up through the circular window to reveal the twilight horizon, the bamboo-and-copper antenna silhouetted against a deep cobalt starry sky. Futuristic yet organic, volumetric light. Sound: subtle soft electronic pulse, calm evening crickets.
shots.voiceover: Chaque station est une ambassade libre. Un nœud de confiance où le savoir et la valeur s'échangent d'égal à égal.

shots.image_prompt: Epic twilight landscape photograph of three glowing white domes nestled in a lush green valley like warm earthen lanterns, in the foreground a small group of friends seen from behind gathered around an outdoor wooden table lit by lanterns raising their glasses toward the starry sky, blue hour, solarpunk renaissance, cinematic wide shot
shots.prompt: Epic slow ascending drone shot at blue hour: the three white eco-domes glow softly from within like warm lanterns across the darkening green valley, the friends at the lantern-lit table clink their glasses in celebration, and the camera rises slowly toward the vast starry sky. Grand, inspiring, emotional climax. Sound: distant joyful clink of glasses, swelling warm orchestral music.
shots.voiceover: Nous ne fuyons pas. Nous reconstruisons ici et maintenant. Le Vaisseau est prêt. Montez à bord.
shots.title: UPLANET • ASTROPORT.ONE — Rejoignez la Constellation
